about.en:
MultiDiverse is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Multilingualism and Cultural Diversity. A joint master's on multilingualism, language acquisition and cultural diversity, linking linguistics, education and psychology. It is coordinated by University of Konstanz in Konstanz (Germany); the consortium: University of Konstanz (Germany), Aristotle University of Thessaloniki (Greece) and Jagiellonian University in Kraków (Poland). Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Bachelor's in linguistics, education, psychology, sociology, speech and language therapy or a related field (German grade 3.0 or better); English at C1 level (exemptions for English-taught degrees). Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official applications page: 2027/28 intake applications 23 Nov 2026 to 15 Jan 2027 via the University of Konstanz portal. Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (120 ECTS).

eligibility.en: Open to all nationalities, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar: Erasmus Mundus scholarships are awarded worldwide on merit, but anyone who has already held an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master scholarship cannot receive another. about.en:
JANUS is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Applied Security and Defence. A joint master's in security and defence studies with three specialisations, combining international relations, law and strategy. It is coordinated by Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3 in Lyon (France); the consortium: Lyon 3 (France) with partners in Bucharest (Romania), Granada (Spain), Essex (UK) and Beirut (Lebanon). Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Bachelor's (180 ECTS) in international relations, law, political science, European studies, security or related; English (TOEFL 90 / IELTS 6.5 / B2 First) and French B2; Spanish B1 if choosing Spain. Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official how-to-apply page: 2027-2029 cohort applications open now and close 6 Jan 2027 (23:59 UTC+1). Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (4 semesters); 33 students, 11 per specialisation.

about.en:

CNE is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Chemical Nano-Engineering. A master's in chemical nano-engineering: nanomaterials, surfaces, polymers and nanochemistry for industry and research. It is coordinated by Aix-Marseille University in Marseille (France); the consortium: Aix-Marseille University (France), University of Rome Tor Vergata (Italy) and Wrocław University of Science and Technology (Poland). Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

about.en:
EMIMEP is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Microwave Electronics and Photonics for Industry. about.en:
NeuroData is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Brain and Data Science. A joint master's combining neuroscience and data science: computational neuroscience, brain imaging, machine learning and neural data analysis. It is coordinated by Bar-Ilan University in Ramat Gan (Israel); the consortium: Bar-Ilan University (Israel, year 1) with second-year partners Instituto Superior Técnico Lisbon (Portugal), University of Jyväskylä (Finland), University of Padua (Italy), VU Amsterdam (Netherlands) and University of Zagreb (Croatia). Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: First degree in neuroscience, biology, psychology, computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering or related; English proficiency (see application requirements). Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official online-application page: the scholarship application system is open 15 Nov 2026 to 5 Feb 2027 (submission deadline); later applications are rejected. Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (120 ECTS): year 1 in Israel, year 2 with research thesis at a European partner.

about.en:
AMASE is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Advanced Materials Science and Engineering. A materials science and engineering master's taught at two of six European technical universities, with full and partial Erasmus Mundus scholarships for 2027. It is coordinated by Saarland University (European School of Materials) in Saarbrücken (Germany); the consortium: Saarland University (Germany), Luleå University of Technology (Sweden), UPC Barcelona (Spain), Université de Lorraine (France), Montanuniversität Leoben (Austria) and University of Padua (Italy); students take two of them and study in two languages. Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Bachelor's in materials science, physics, chemistry, mechanical or process engineering or related; English proficiency and basics of a second programme language as required by the chosen universities (see application requirements). Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.

Timeline: Official deadlines page: intake 2027/28 Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline 15 Jan 2027 if starting at LTU, 15 Feb 2027 if starting at UPC, UdS, UL, MUL or UNIPD; self-funded deadlines 31 Mar / 31 May 2027. Erasmus Mundus scholarships go to the top-ranked applicants and cover all participation costs (tuition and insurance) plus €1,400 a month for up to 24 months. Duration: 2 years (4 semesters, 120 ECTS).
